envelope.description: runTurn gains an optional suppressEcho flag gating the user-row echo (ac2/k1)

body.title: runTurn gains an optional suppressEcho flag gating the user-row echo (ac2/k1)
body.summary: Add the optional third parameter opts?: { readonly suppressEcho?: boolean } to runTurn (chat-panel.ts:527) and gate the user-row echo post (chat-panel.ts:543) on it (default off = today's behaviour). The resume turn + tool grant are otherwise unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: runTurn's signature gains an optional opts.suppressEcho; existing call-sites compile unchanged (backward-compatible).
When suppressEcho is true the user-row echo post at :543 is skipped; when absent/false it posts exactly as today.
The resume turn + [toolName] grant behaviour is unchanged regardless of suppressEcho.

tests.name: a NORMAL user turn still posts its user-row echo (suppressEcho off by default)
